full_scope: For every 3<p<infinity in R^3, with delta=1-3/p, the supremum over all R>0 of the spherical Bochner-Riesz means with multiplier (1-|xi|^2/R^2)_+^delta maps L^{p,1} to L^p, with a constant depending only on p.
paid_range: Lee-Rogers-Seeger arXiv1207.6582v1 Corollary1.3 already proves p>4. Lee-Seeger proves a.e. convergence on L^{p,1} for all p>3, not this global norm.
